stories.headline: Azerbaijan Natural Gas Exports to Italy Reach $3.2 Billion in First Nine Months
stories.summary: Azerbaijan delivered 6.2 billion cubic meters of natural gas valued at $3.2 billion to Italy between January and September.
stories.why: Italy relies on Azeri pipeline supplies via the Trans Adriatic Pipeline to diversify its European energy imports away from Russia.

stories.headline: Customers Struggle to Pay Installments, Non-Performing Loans of 5 Leasing Companies Reach 5%
stories.summary: The OJK financial regulator reported five finance companies with NPF ratios above 5% as of September 2026. Industry net profit still grew 22.80% year on year despite the challenges.
stories.why: Non-performing financing ratios show credit quality at leasing companies, which lend to consumers and businesses and are closely watched for systemic credit risk.
stories.original_headline: Nasabah Kesulitan Bayar Cicilan, Kredit Macet 5 Leasing Tembus 5%

stories.headline: Petrol imports jump 47% despite local refining
stories.summary: Nigeria's petrol imports rose 47% to 15 million litres per day in October, according to NMDPRA data. The increase came despite higher output from domestic refineries.
stories.why: Nigeria is a major oil producer, but it imports much of its refined fuel, so import volumes affect the country's fuel supply, foreign-exchange demand and the refining sector's competitiveness.

stories.headline: LSE Financial Services Launches AI Trading Order Management System for Pakistan Brokers
stories.summary: LSE Financial Services launched an AI-enabled Order Management System integrated with its back-office software, serving 60 brokerages on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
stories.why: Modernizing trading software infrastructure helps improve market execution and transaction liquidity across emerging frontier bourses.

stories.headline: Nigeria’s crypto economy down 3%
stories.summary: Nigeria's crypto economy fell 3% to $38.1bn in the year to June 2026, according to Chainalysis, as decentralised exchange activity dropped 45% amid tighter SEC and CBN rules.
stories.why: Nigeria has been one of the largest crypto markets by transaction volume, and regulation by the SEC and central bank shapes how digital assets are traded there.

stories.headline: Quebecor and Telesat Explore Partnership on Lightspeed Satellite Constellation
stories.summary: Quebecor and Telesat held preliminary talks regarding potential technology collaboration on Telesat's low-Earth orbit Lightspeed satellite constellation, though no capital deal has been finalized.
stories.why: LEO satellite networks are becoming critical infrastructure for enterprise connectivity and broadband access across remote territories.

stories.headline: SHCP withdraws fiscal stimulus on Magna gasoline and lowers diesel subsidy
stories.summary: Mexico's finance ministry (SHCP) withdrew the IEPS fiscal stimulus on Magna gasoline and reduced the diesel subsidy. Diesel keeps a stimulus for the week of November 21 to 27.
stories.why: Fuel tax incentives directly affect pump prices and inflation, which matter to Mexican fuel retailers, transport costs and the government's fiscal position.

stories.headline: Peru Extends S/ 2 Billion Credit Repayment Relief for Small Businesses Under El Niño
stories.summary: Peru's Ministry of Economy and Finance activated S/ 2,000 million in guarantees and authorized up to 12-month debt rescheduling under Impulso Myperú to support businesses impacted by El Niño.
stories.why: State-backed guarantee programs protect liquidity for micro and small enterprises against severe climatic shocks in Peru.
